before: Suggest a diet to lose weight. Under 100 words.
after: Suggest a diet to lose weight. Under 100 words. This is for me: 34, bank job, sitting 9 hours, vegetarian, lunch from the office canteen, dinner at 9:30 pm with family.

before: Suggest a high-protein dinner. Under 80 words.
after: Suggest a high-protein dinner. Under 80 words. Must: vegetarian, no eggs, under Rs 100, cooked on one gas burner. Must not: protein powder.

before: Suggest 5 names for our 6 am gym WhatsApp group.
after: Suggest 5 names for our 6 am gym WhatsApp group. We like names like "Sore But Showing Up" and "Alarm Beaters 5:30".

before: How do I deadlift with correct form?
after: How do I deadlift with correct form? Answer in 5 bullets, in the order I do them, max 8 words each.

before: Make me a 12-week plan to go from no running to a 5 km run. Under 150 words.
after: Make me a 12-week plan to go from no running to a 5 km run. Give me weeks 1 and 2 only, under 80 words. Then stop and ask me how it went.

before: Make me a weekly workout plan. Under 100 words.
after: Make me a weekly workout plan. Under 100 words. Before you start, ask me up to 3 questions.

before: I'm 78 kg and want to lose fat. Tell me my daily calories and protein.
after: I'm 78 kg and want to lose fat. Tell me my daily calories and protein. Use only what I told you. Where you need something I didn't give, write [ASK ME] instead of assuming.

before: Give me one day of vegetarian eating: 1,800 calories and 100 g protein. Under 120 words.
after: Give me one day of vegetarian eating: 1,800 calories and 100 g protein. Under 120 words. Show calories and protein next to each item, add them up, and tell me honestly if the total misses my targets.
